None of them is a list of morphism properties insensitive to a cartesian thickening of the base.

Public 465 (tag 07RT, more-morphisms-lemma-pushout-along-thickening) and public 491 (tag 0E25) are the nearest neighbours in subject matter, since both construct pushouts of thickenings; the counted statement instead compares f with f' for eleven properties, and its proof uses the diagonal of X' over S' rather than a pushout.

Public 463 (tag 0D4F, lemma-deform-projective) reconstructs a projective thickening with an ample lift, and public 486 (tag 0H41) studies base change of scheme-theoretic images after a finite type thickening of the base; both concern thickenings but neither states or implies the permanence list counted here.

The two Stacks tags that support this proof inside the same chapter, 09ZV (lemma-thicken-property-morphisms) and 09ZU (lemma-base-change-thickening), and the counted tag itself, 09ZW, do not occur in reference/public-items.jsonl, so neither this statement nor its immediate supporting lemmas has been counted before.
